messages:
mika: Caption contest: best one-liner for the office fern pic wins forever glory. go!
sam: Office plant or secret intern? :seedling:
jordan: Filing for guardian of plant 3. `I water, therefore I am`
elliot: Fern: 'I see you refilling the water cooler, human.' :sunglasses:
harper: @sam that is now the official job title
sam: :raising_hand: willing to volunteer if snacks involved
mika: Bonus points for rhymes. no more than 6 words. judged by @mika and @giphy-bot
giphy-bot: Posted a dramatic gif - https://giphy.com/fake/gif123
jordan: Fern CEO, quietly judging our staplers.
elliot: Silent but deadly (to cactus repopulation).
harper: Vote? :thumbsup: for jordan, :heart: for elliot, :laughing: for sam
sam: I feel personally attacked by the stapler comment
mika: Tallying votes... also can someone claim the plant watering calendar this week?
sam: I can do Thu/Fri. :calendar:
jordan: I'll take Mon-Wed. can't let it thirst on my watch.
harper: Thanks! Adding to #office-chart
sam: :tada: plant care crew assembled
mika: Winner (by emoji consensus): jordan — 'Fern CEO, quietly judging our staplers.' Prize: eternal bragging rights + sticker.
jordan: I'll accept and demand a tiny podium.
giphy-bot: Reaction: :trophy:
elliot: Podium made from spare pizza boxes?
harper: Please no. Podium = trip hazard
sam: `mkdir podium` might be easier
mika: Ok team — quick poll: should we rename 'Desk 12' to 'Fern District'?
harper: :thumbsup: yes
elliot: :thumbsdown: maybe
sam: :confused: undecided
jordan: Proceed with caution. but yes.
mika: Renaming plan accepted. I'll file the tiny sticky-note deed.
sam: :seedling: long live Fern District
mika: :end:
